data.title: UnexpectedValueException: Log file not available

labels.name: 0. Needs triage
labels.description: Pending check for reproducibility or if it fits our roadmap

data.body:
### Steps to reproduce
1. Log in as admin
2. Choose settings -> logging (from administration menu)
3. Select the 3 dots next to "Level" and click on "Download logs"

### Expected behaviour
Server should collect logging data and offer result as a downloadable file

### Actual behaviour
Error comes up - Internal sever error (on screen - see attachment). Logging says:

   dispatch(OC\Settings\Cont ... {}, "download")
